reason: The cited evidence shows that Al+Ti additions can form L12 precipitates in FCC HEAs (E1) and that short-range order exists in Al–Co–Cr–Fe–Ni systems (E2), but none of the passages demonstrate that Al content alone controls short-range ordering, that ordering directly causes L12 precipitation, or that L12 precipitates stabilize a single-phase microstructure while retaining cryogenic toughness and radiation tolerance. The mechanistic links between ordering, phase stability, and multifunctional properties are unsupported by the cited evidence.
